title: Custom food
prompt:
Generate ONE high-fidelity portrait native ANDROID screen for Lockout, an offline strength training app. This is a full Material 3 EXPRESSIVE 2025/2026 redesign, NOT old generic Material, iOS, or a website. One screen only, centered front-on inside a VERY slim graphite Pixel-like Android frame, tiny centered punch-hole camera, all edges visible, even narrow outer margins on a neutral pale gray studio backdrop. Screen fills almost entire image, very crisp readable typography. Roughly 412x915 dp viewport; full image portrait 2:3, use generous readable type rather than squeezing. Same design system across all screens: light cool ivory/off-white subtly green-tinted surface #F7FAF0; deep charcoal-green text #1B2515; chosen accent Rep lime #C2EE7B generates whole scheme; secondary pale lavender #E7DDF7 and tertiary pale peach #FFDCC6 with dark matching foregrounds. These are purposeful Material container roles, no gradients, no glass, no neon glows, no drop shadows except genuinely raised sheets. Bricolage Grotesque rounded bold headings, Figtree readable body, aligned tabular numbers only where needed. Strong hierarchy, 20dp outer margins, 16dp internal padding, generous spacing, 48dp+ targets. Expressive filled and tonal capsule buttons, asymmetric soft corner containers, connected list groups with 3dp gaps and large outer corners, Material Symbols rounded icons. Icon badges EACH use a distinct real Material shape (flower, scallop, rounded gem, pentagon, soft burst, arch, clover), not identical circles. Real text and content stay inside rounded rectangles, never irregularly masked. Expressive nav selection indicator deforms into a rounded lozenge with clear readable icon+label, full-width grounded navigation surface, never floating iOS dock. Android status bar 9:41, Wi-Fi/battery and bottom gesture inset. Sentence case only. Content values are illustrative preview examples, no invented accounts, subscription, cloud or social features. One dominant focal area, real task clarity, all UI beautifully buildable in Flutter. Keep UI text readable, no giant nonfunctional decorative artwork. No exterior title, annotations or watermark.
Reference is style only: preserve font, color roles, slim Android frame and component language, but compose this NEW task-specific screen. Solid flat fills, no gradients. SCREEN: Custom food
Focused form route. Back arrow, title 'Custom food'. Filled rounded text field 'Food name' value 'Homemade lentil soup'. Filled serving text field 'Serving' value '1 bowl'. Two-column readable macro inputs 'Calories' value '240' with kcal, 'Protein' '14 g', 'Carbs' '32 g', 'Fat' '6 g'. Meal slot selection 'Dinner' selected among four expressive segmented options. Optional note field labeled 'Ingredients or notes'. Primary sticky action 'Save food'. All form surfaces use expressive soft rounded corners, visible labels and strong contrast. No nav.
notes: Concept preview only; illustrative data. Not an implementation or accessibility certification.
